_description: VG-CND04-PROVENANCE cases (18.122): each case is one bundle for the fixture subject; expected is CND-04's outcome, the failing event ids and the assess exit code, with nothing quarantined, the same in Python, TypeScript and Java. A ToolCall or consequential Decision fails CND-04 when the instruction it acts on does not show a chain ending at an authorised principal: the instruction, or one on its refs.parent / refs.origin lineage, is of an untrusted Appendix F class or names nothing the bundle holds; a user, operator, service or agent_identified instruction records no principal; the principal's role is not one the task type's authorised_principal_roles lists; or the delegation the call rests on records agentce:chainVerified false. A delegation only the agent reports, no delegation, or a principal with no role reads insufficient_evidence, never conformant (SPEC §7.7.4, §6.2.3, §6.3, §7.7.5, §7.7.6, HR-5). Generated from the trust matrix's instruction_chain builder (verification/gates/fixtures/trust_matrix/build.py).

toolcall-verified-principal.why: a call and the consequential decision it executes act on an attested user instruction whose principal's role the task type authorises, under an enforcement-point delegation whose chain verified

toolcall-chain-unverified.why: the call's delegation records agentce:chainVerified false

toolcall-chain-ends-at-tool-output.why: the acted-on instruction is tool output: the chain ends at no principal

toolcall-user-instruction-no-principal.why: a user instruction that records no principal does not end at an authorised principal (SPEC §6.2.3)

decision-consequential-chain-unverified.why: the consequential decision acts on the instruction and the call executing it rests on an unverified delegation

decision-consequential-verified-principa.why: the consequential decision and its executing call both act on an attested service instruction with a principal, verified delegation

decision-consequential-call-names-no-ins.why: twin of decision-consequential-chain-unverified: verified delegation, so only the call, which names no instruction, fails; the decision passes

toolcall-two-hop-ends-at-tool-output.why: the acted-on user instruction derives (refs.parent) from a tool_output instruction

toolcall-two-hop-ends-at-user.why: twin: two refs.parent hops, all user with a principal

toolcall-operator-principal.why: twin: an operator instruction with a principal

toolcall-service-no-principal.why: a service instruction with no principal

toolcall-agent-identified-no-principal.why: an agent_identified instruction with no principal

toolcall-delegation-self-reported.why: the delegation's chainVerified true is the agent's own record

toolcall-role-not-authorised.why: the principal's role is not one the task type authorises

toolcall-self-report-corroborated.why: twin: a self-reported instruction an enforcement-point PolicyDecision names, with the principal and role

toolcall-self-report-corroborated-other-.why: the enforcement point records another role for the principal

toolcall-chain-unverified-corroborated.why: corroboration does not lift an unverified delegation

toolcall-instruction-not-held.why: refs.instruction names nothing the bundle holds

decision-only-chain-ends-at-tool-output.why: a consequential decision no call executes acts on tool output
